facts.text: Inn by the Sea is located on a mile of sandy beach on the coast of Maine.
facts.excerpt: Inn by the Sea is located on a mile of sandy beach on the coast of Maine.

facts.text: Crescent Beach, a salt-water beach with relatively warm water, is reached from the inn by a private boardwalk.
facts.excerpt: Relatively warm water at  this classic salt-water beach is just a private boardwalk away for a day of fun in the sun.

facts.text: The property is in Cape Elizabeth, about a 15-minute drive from downtown Portland, Maine.
facts.excerpt: this Cape Elizabeth property a 15-minute drive from downtown

facts.text: Guestrooms and one- or two-bedroom suites have private exterior entrances.
facts.excerpt: offers sixty-two guestrooms and one or two-bedroom suites with private exterior entrances

facts.text: Pet-friendly accommodations are offered.
facts.excerpt: With thoughtfully designed accommodations—including pet-friendly options—every stay is tailored for comfort and ease.

facts.text: The reviewed beach suite had views of Crescent Beach, a private outdoor patio, a fully equipped kitchen, a gas fireplace, a steam shower and an extra-large bathtub.
facts.excerpt: a private outdoor patio, a fully equipped kitchen, gas burning fireplace, steam shower and an extra-large bathtub, and a king-sized bedroom

facts.text: Garden suites and loft suites in the main house often have two floors, Atlantic views, private decks and kitchenettes.
facts.excerpt: many have two floors and dramatic views of the Atlantic, private decks, equipped kitchenettes, and bathroom suites with deep soaking tubs

facts.text: All of the property's clean electricity comes from solar, and guests have composting programs.
facts.excerpt: green energy (100% of the property’s clean electricity comes from solar), and composting programs for guests

facts.text: The inn runs environmental programs and long-term commitments to restore the surrounding land, with green design throughout.
facts.excerpt: with environmental programs, long-term commitments to restore the land it around it, and green design throughout

facts.text: The spa offers massages, facials and body treatments, with private relaxation sanctuaries, steam rooms and experience showers.
facts.excerpt: offers a variety of massages, facials, and body treatments, complemented by private relaxation sanctuaries, steam rooms, and experience showers

facts.text: Spa treatments use marine-based skincare products with seaweed extracts and marine peptides.
facts.excerpt: our spa treatments feature carefully selected marine-based skincare products rich in rejuvenating seaweed extracts, marine peptides

facts.text: The resort has an outdoor swimming pool and private cabanas.
facts.excerpt: outdoor swimming pool, private cabanas, and direct access to beautiful Crescent Beach

facts.text: The fitness center has Peloton bikes and on-demand fitness classes.
facts.excerpt: our fitness center, featuring modern cardio and strength-training equipment, Peloton bikes, and on-demand fitness classes

facts.text: Morning yoga is a mixed-level class overlooking the Atlantic, for adults only, available daily.
facts.excerpt: Refresh the body & mind with a mixed level class overlooking the Atlantic. Meet in the fitness center, yoga mats provided. Adults only, available daily.

facts.text: On property there are weekly Beach Ecology Walks, Garden Tours and Great Pond Walks.
facts.excerpt: On property, we offer a variety of ways to experience Cape Elizabeth with weekly Beach Ecology Walks, Garden Tours, Great Pond Walks

facts.text: Several lighthouses are a short drive or bike ride away, and guests can pack a picnic lunch from Sea Glass.
facts.excerpt: The coast of Maine is speckled with lighthouses - with a handful just short drive or bike ride away. Pack a picnic lunch from Sea Glass for a day lit with exploring.

facts.text: Sea Glass restaurant uses ingredients from Maine farms and fishermen.
facts.excerpt: Our restaurant features the freshest ingredients from land and sea provided by the wonderful farms and fisherman of the great state of Maine.

facts.text: Full lobster bakes can be delivered to the suites.
facts.excerpt: To suites like these, the property delivers full lobster bakes, along with the rest of the menu from Sea Glass

facts.text: The inn partners with BabyQuip so families can rent baby gear.
facts.excerpt: we have partnered with BabyQuip to make your family travel at Inn by the Sea a breeze

facts.text: The lawn has Adirondack chairs with coast views.
facts.excerpt: Its pristine lawn, dotted with Adirondack chairs, offers views of the coast

facts.text: Spa services and amenities are reserved for guests 18 and older; the minimum age for services is 16 when accompanied by an adult.
facts.excerpt: Minimum age for services is 16 accompanied by guest of 18 years or older. Spa services and amenities are reserved for guests 18 years of age and older.

facts.text: Advance reservations are required for all spa services.
facts.excerpt: Advance reservations are required for all SPA services.

facts.text: Wi-Fi is free.

facts.excerpt: The hotel offers complimentary valet and self-parking on-site.
